Mira: Quick check—finalizing the benchmark slides. Plan: 3 visuals (latency vs $/1M, cache->$ per session, SLA buckets) + 2 micro-hooks. Can people confirm asset owners?
James: I'll own latency vs cost chart. Will annotate knee and add small inset for outliers.
Sophia: I'll write the two hooks and short captions. Draft hook 1: 'Measure inference where it matters: $/active session.' Hook 2: 'Choose SLAs that match your product, not your ego.'
benchbot: uploaded data: https://redwood.share/bench/2240020000.csv 5 includes p50/p95 and cache-sweep.
beth_marketing: I'll draft the social card and the UTM suggestions (?seg=latency, ?seg=econ). Also prepping one-liner for email subject.
Mira: Thanks. James—please keep colors <=3 and label the UX-knee between 75-200ms. Sophia—captions due 9am. Beth—social copy after captions locked.
James: noted, will deliver svg by 7pm.
Sophia: captions will be in the deck comments by 8:30am.
Mira: Perfect. If anyone sees customer examples of trading latency for cost, DM me for a quote. Closing thread, update in the deck.
